subject: gpg
track: Grade 6 Regelklasse; the M-Zug starts in Grade 7.
hours: The official page does not allocate hours to the learning area.

rows.competence: erklären die unterschiedlichen Lebensformen im Kloster und auf der Burg, um geistliche und weltliche Machtstrukturen zu vergleichen.
rows.evidence: Labelled castle and monastery diagrams, workshop cases on work, education and a monastery court, and a comparison of the rights and responsibilities of a duke and an abbot.
rows.additional: A local castle or monastery visit can provide evidence about an individual site.

rows.competence: stellen den hierarchischen Aufbau der mittelalterlichen Ständegesellschaft dar, um die individuellen Freiheiten in unserer Gesellschaft heute zu bewerten.
rows.evidence: Three-estate diagram and classification, town and countryside comparison, and written judgments about occupational freedom, legal equality and the practical ability to exercise rights.
rows.additional: Learners can discuss how different answers weigh practical barriers to using a right.
